Values.//mms: MmsProvider is reached over HTTP as a peer system. Leaving the base URL empty disables the ingest leg rather than failing it, so the engine can run before MMS is up.
Values.//sites: Enterprise-level SyncSites creates MMS owners before approved segments are filed.
Values.//segments: Bootstrap operations subscriptions before approval/replay. CIR destination-category equivalence support is required.
Values.//cir: Registering the site's identity so other systems can resolve MMS's key space. Empty CirBaseUrl leaves the site written but unregistered.
